scenes.heading: Understanding image licensing and usage rights

sents.d: Understanding image licensing and usage rights
Clarify who can use images, where, and for how long — before the shoot.

Clients often assume they own unlimited rights to use delivered images anywhere, while photographers may have intended a more limited personal-use license — this mismatch causes some of the most common photography disputes.

scenes.heading: Get model releases at the shoot

sents.d: A model release is necessary for any commercial use of images featuring recognizable people, and should be signed before or during the shoot, not requested afterward when someone may be less willing to sign.

Charging separately for commercial or extended usage rights versus personal use gives you a legitimate way to earn more from brand or business clients who need broader usage than a family or individual would.

take: Define usage in writing and get releases on the day.
